ui_intent: Public proof surfaces for landing, pricing, and trust-building panels

glass_box_walkthrough.title: Sample Glass Box Replay
glass_box_walkthrough.headline: Every decision shows what the model saw, when it saw it, and whether the timing was clean.

timeline.detail: Last market snapshot ingested before decision boundary.
Feature bundle compiled from pre-decision bars only.
Setup score crossed threshold with no future-bar leakage.
Risk ladder built from contemporaneous volatility state.
Decision emitted with lineage and timing envelope intact.

honest_pf_demo.headline: Aggregate PF can flatter. Avg Daily PF shows whether edge repeats day after day.
honest_pf_demo.method_note: Finite daily PF values are averaged. Fully profitable zero-loss days are reported separately and excluded from the finite mean.

evidence_blocks.headline: Decision timestamps are first-class data, not afterthoughts.
evidence_blocks.body: Public proof surfaces should show a compact event ladder with ingest, feature build, signal evaluation, and decision emit states.

evidence_blocks.headline: Show the flattering number and the stricter one side by side.
evidence_blocks.body: Use aggregate PF for context, then pair it with Avg Daily PF and a one-line methodology explainer.

evidence_blocks.headline: The page should feel like a live workstation, not generic SaaS chrome.
evidence_blocks.body: Dense strips, ranked tables, state colors, and microcopy should communicate urgency and confidence without resorting to noise.
